description: Recalculates an approved quote and creates offered, unsigned policies, ready for the customer to review and sign on Plain. Send the exact quote request again with its quoteId before expiresAt; offers are created for the products with status.value quoted only. Active insurance is rechecked before creation. Retry a failed request on the same connection with the same idempotency key and body. No insurance is accepted, activated or charged. When state.value is awaiting_verification, ask the person for the emailed code. Creates offers for the selected, authorized existing company without recreating it, or onboards a new company. For an existing company, select it with set_company_context and use its CVR; administrator access is required. Uses the connected user's identity: omit email and name. Requires signing in with onboarding:write consent; calling it prompts sign-in when needed. Check list_companies first. idempotencyKey is required. If the connected user's email is confirmed, no email code is needed. Do not reuse a retry key across reconnections; obtain a fresh quote after expiry or insurance changes.

inputSchema.description: Creates unsigned offers from an approved quote; public signup also creates the company.

email.description: Email address of the person signing up; a verification code is sent here.

idempotencyKey.description: Random key of 32-128 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. Retry a failed request with the same key and body.

name.description: Full name of the person signing up. Must not contain links or markup.

quote.description: The company, products and answers to price. Send the same object again in /start.

additionalProperties.description: The answer's JSON type follows the catalog question's `type.value`: Text is a string; NumberWhole is an integer and NumberDecimal a number (numeric strings are accepted); Date is a YYYY-MM-DD string; Boolean is true or false; Select is one option key from `options` as a string; MultiSelect is an array of option keys.

answers.description: Every answer in one object, keyed by the catalog question `name`. A plain name answers that question for the company and for every selected product that asks it; `<product>.<name>` (e.g. loesoereforsikring.basement) answers only that product's question and takes precedence. Employee FTE questions are answered as `<name>.fullTime` and `<name>.partTime` head counts: integers from 0 to 9999 inclusive. When required, send both counts explicitly, including zero.

cvr.description: Danish company registration number (CVR), eight digits, e.g. 39488914.

partnerCode.description: Optional partner discount code, 2-64 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. Must be active.

products.description: The products to quote: 1 to 20 distinct slugs, including any products they require.

region.description: Market. Only Denmark (dk) is supported. Optional; defaults to dk.

startDate.description: Policy start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today. Must be between today and one year ahead.

quoteId.description: The `quoteId` of the quote the person approved.

name: create_onboarding

capability.description: Secret proof of this signup. Keep it private and send it with onboardingId.

continuationToken.description: Secret token for /payment-handoff, valid for 15 minutes after verification.

policyIds.description: IDs of the offered policies, once created.

state.description: awaiting_verification: ask the person for the emailed code; email_confirmed: call /verify-email again to finish; verified: offers are ready.

title: Create unsigned insurance offers
